# BPMN Desk 0.7.1

- Keep the new-tab button next to the last tab while tabs fit, and visible at the right edge when they overflow.
- Scroll tabs without edge jumps: arrow buttons overlay the fading edges without changing the available width. Use the regular mouse wheel, horizontal scrolling or Shift.
- Close tabs with the middle mouse button, with the usual confirmation for unsaved changes.
- Refresh the README screenshots, including the split light/dark editor preview, start page, monitor and execution history.

Linux AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` are available. Windows executables are unsigned; macOS is not available.
